verdict.rationale: Unstructured documents a public API that can be called through REST clients (cURL, Postman) and a Python SDK. Its API reference covers partitioning, enrichment, chunking and embedding, plus programmatic create, update, run and delete for workflows, job triggering and monitoring, and source-connector management. That is enough for an AI-native user to drive the product end to end. Missing for 10: a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec (every probed path returned 404) and independent hands-on corroboration of the API in use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: You can call the Unstructured API with the Unstructured Python SDK and with standard REST clients (such as cURL and Postman).
You can call the Unstructured API through REST endpoints by using a REST client (such as cURL or Postman) to partition, enrich, chunk, and embed your files.
Build and manage Unstructured workflows with the Python SDK or REST endpoints. Create, update, run, and delete workflows that process and transform documents from source to destination.
Trigger runs, monitor status, download results, and inspect any files that failed during processing.
Reference the Unstructured Platform API endpoints and settings for creating, listing, updating, and deleting workflow source connectors.
